name: sessclone
description: Sends Claude Code usage to a SessClone deployment.

url.title: Deployment URL
url.description: Leave empty for the hosted service at https://sessclone.com. Self-hosted deployments enter their own address, the same one their dashboard is on.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Create one in the dashboard under Keys. It is shown once and kept in your keychain. Leave empty in a Claude Code cloud environment whose SessClone API credential adds it.
